name: Alkaline water electrolysis
principle: Two electrodes sit in a liquid alkaline electrolyte of potassium or sodium hydroxide, separated by a diaphragm. Water is split by direct current: hydrogen forms at the cathode and oxygen at the anode, and the electrolyte circulates through gas separators. DOE gives an operating range of 60 to 90 °C.

process_steps.name: Electrolysis stacks
equipment: KOH electrolyte circulation pumps and coolers

advantages: Most deployed electrolysis technology at large scale
No platinum-group metals in the cell
limitations: Slower response to fluctuating power than PEM in conventional designs
Lower current density, so larger stacks
